RESULT: DONE

CHANGED: docs/feature/wp4.md

TESTS: (planning-only doc change — no production code written, so no `pytest`/`tsc` against new code; the per-item `pending_signoff`/board-list shapes come from WP2/WP3 which are not yet built and depend on the WP0 migration that is not yet applied)

CHECKLIST:
#1 FIXED — BoardView→ItemDetail/WaitingOnYou wiring + shared boardRefreshKey now owned by WP4-T1 via `BoardContext.tsx` (shared `boardRefreshKey`/`bumpRefresh`) + stub `ItemDetail.tsx`/`WaitingOnYou.tsx` (defining `ItemDetailProps`/`WaitingOnYouProps`); T2/T3 replace the stubs (serialized via deps, so T2||T3 stay parallel).
#2 FIXED — activate dropdown dropped: there is no WP3 list endpoint (`GET …/workflow` returns only the active workflow); activate now targets a known `workflow_id` (just-created or displayed); a `GET /teams/{team_id}/workflows` list endpoint is flagged as a future WP3 item.
#3 FIXED — removed the "Route ordering" section; Next.js App Router resolves static `remap` before dynamic `[workflow_id]` automatically and no WP4 task creates either page (remap is an in-page form in T4a).
#4 FIXED — T5 renamed to a WP3-only shape-contract test (`test_mindmap_workflow_web_ui_shapes.py`, seeds via raw asyncpg, depends on WP3 only, no React); `npx tsc --noEmit (from web/)` acceptance added to T1, T2, T3, T4a, T4b (no React test runner is configured).
#5 FIXED — T4 split into T4a (page + settings shell: active view, create, activate button, remap, members fetch, writes+refresh) and T4b (bulky `WorkflowEditor` stages/transitions editor); T3 asserts `PendingSignoffOutput` carries `node_id` (pinned + asserted by T5); per-item field resolved to `pending_signoff` (singular, per WP2 `WorkItemWithMovesOutput`) while the list endpoint stays `pending-signoffs`; also corrected card content to `WorkItemOutput.title` (no `content` field exists).

NOTES:
- Only `docs/feature/wp4.md` modified; no source/test code touched, so nothing to compile/test now (the tsc/pytest gates are for later engineer sessions once WP0–WP3 land).
- Verified the embedded ```json block parses with 6 tasks and all required keys (id/title/files/tests/deps/acceptance/context).
- Stub handoff (T1's `ItemDetail.tsx`/`WaitingOnYou.tsx` replaced by T2/T3) is the one intentional file shared across a dependency — documented in NOTES so it is not mistaken for an ownership violation; T2||T3 remain parallelizable since they touch disjoint files.
- `team_id` source pinned as a WP2/WP3 contract (`WorkListOutput.team_id`, asserted by T5) since the existing `MapPayload` has no `team_id`.
- `node_id` join: `PendingSignoffOutput` must expose `node_id` (= the item's `WorkItemOutput.node_id`) so T3 can match pending-signoff rows to board items; T5 asserts this.
